fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Discover
fields.Description: Walks each Content Source selected by the Record Process filter and records what it found as Content Items. Sources selected for a Discover run are always walked; a completed walk clears ForceDiscovery and stamps LastDiscoveredAt.

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Sync
fields.Description: Exhaustively walks each selected Content Source (ignoring LastDiscoveredAt), reconciles top-level items that were removed from the source by marking them DeleteStatus = 'Pending' for the Delete stage, and stamps both LastDiscoveredAt and LastSyncedAt on completion. Selects sources by LastSyncedAt (never by ForceDiscovery, which belongs to Discover); to force a sync on a source, set its LastSyncedAt back or to NULL. Unscheduled by default.
fields.ScopeFilter: LastSyncedAt IS NULL OR LastSyncedAt < DATEADD(day, -30, GETUTCDATE())

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Extract
fields.Description: Fetches each pending Content Item and reads its text, opening a session first when its source needs one. An artifact that is not text keeps its bytes as an MJ File and routes to the multi-modal path instead.
fields.ScopeFilter: (ExtractionStatus IS NULL OR ExtractionStatus = 'Pending') AND (DeleteStatus IS NULL)

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Tag
fields.Description: Classifies each pending Content Item through the managed Content Autotagging prompt and saves the result to MJ: Content Item Tags, promoting each tag through the governed taxonomy.
fields.ScopeFilter: (TaggingStatus IS NULL OR TaggingStatus = 'Pending') AND (DeleteStatus IS NULL)

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Segment
fields.Description: Splits each pending Content Item's text into Content Item Chunks using the segmenter its source or content type names. A re-segmentation mints a fresh set of chunks and marks the previous set for deletion, so a chunk always means the text it was created with.
fields.ScopeFilter: (SegmentationStatus IS NULL OR SegmentationStatus = 'Pending') AND (DeleteStatus IS NULL)

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Embed
fields.Description: Embeds each pending Content Item Chunk and stores the vector in the index its source or content type names, recording VectorRecordID so the vector can be removed later. Batched: one model call and one store call per page.
fields.ScopeFilter: (EmbeddingStatus IS NULL OR EmbeddingStatus IN ('Pending','MetadataOnly')) AND (DeleteStatus IS NULL)

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Delete
fields.Description: Removes everything a Content Item marked for deletion produced — its vector, its kept bytes — then marks its chunks and expanded children for removal. Its chunks are removed by the Delete Chunks process, its child items by this one in turn. A record whose removal could not be attempted stays Pending rather than being marked Deleted.

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Delete Chunks
fields.Description: Removes the vector of each Content Item Chunk marked for deletion — a deleted item's chunks, and the chunks a re-segmentation replaced. A chunk nothing references is then removed outright; one that something references (usage history, a citation) is kept as a tombstone so that history still points at real text.

fields.Name: Content Pipeline — Test (Discover then Extract)
fields.Description: A chained dry run over a single source: walks it, then extracts what the walk produced, and commits nothing. The produced items exist only in memory, which is what makes this a test of the chain rather than of two stages that happen to have run.
